The '''Blimph system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Blimph]] and its inhabited [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Tertiary Moon of Blimph|Blimph 3]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[Quaffug]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] ruled its criminal underworld as "Overboss" until just before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Malta and Quaffug">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031009hutt|text=Hutt! Hutt! Hutt! #3}}</ref>
